topics.topic: Choose the permitted source for the diagnostic item name: a canonical RuntimeSettings schema reference or an imported constant
questions: The diagnostic item name must be supplied through one of the permitted value paths—restore a canonical `= models.RuntimeSettings` schema reference that exposes the field name, or provide the item name as an imported constant—instead of deriving the emitted value from the parameter's name.

quotes: probe_backup_location: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer a ProbePassed when the probe file was created and removed, and otherwise a StartDiagnostic whose diagnostic names the backup_dir item by the name of its backup_dir parameter, which is that item's field name, as every start diagnostic names an item, and what failed, the location missing or not a directory or the file not created or not removed, never the location's path; a probe file it could not remove MUST be left where it is, for the next run's removal of temporary files.
judgement.why: The note makes the generated code obtain the diagnostic item value from prose about a parameter name rather than through one of the permitted value paths.
judgement.rule: Адрес, записанный без `=` — в обратных кавычках или словами, — не разыменовывается вовсе: до модели не доходит ни значение, ни символ, и она вынуждена значение сочинить. Обе формы невалидны для значения, которое читает генерируемый код.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.

For an enum-to-enum lookup, resolve the typed table before rewriting the note (SPEC_STANDARD §15.2 and §6.10 v2). Use python tools/design_enum_map.py template --help, fill rows, then preview and apply in the case checkout.
